statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-96957 is a .NET SDK security feature bypass in file-based apps (dotnet run with a single C# file): NuGet package signature verification for file-based apps can fail to enforce the expected trust decision. Microsoft lists Windows, Linux and macOS as affected platforms and the .NET SDK 10.0.1xx feature band as affected from 10.0.100 through 10.0.112 and fixed in 10.0.113, shipped with .NET 10.0.13 (https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/487, https://github.com/dotnet/sdk/issues/56615, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/10.0/10.0.13/10.0.13.md). The fix enables NuGet signature verification when the SDK builds file-based apps, in VirtualProjectBuildingCommand and NuGetSignatureVerificationEnabler of the SDK command-line code (dotnet/dotnet commit 7418bf8eeda784946c1de259f5d6c389c5deef46 on release/10.0.1xx; the dotnet/dotnet v10.0.113 source tag, from which the 10.0.13 runtime and SDK 10.0.113 are built, contains it and v10.0.112 does not: https://github.com/dotnet/dotnet/commit/7418bf8eeda784946c1de259f5d6c389c5deef46). DHI dotnet10-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 10 for Linux from Microsoft's dotnet/dotnet source release, and each build's version is the .NET release it carries. Scanned all 264 packages of the twelve published builds (10.0.2-r0, 10.0.3-r0, 10.0.4-r0, 10.0.5-r0, 10.0.6-r0, 10.0.7-r0, 10.0.8-r0, 10.0.9-r0, 10.0.10-r0, 10.0.13-r0, 10.0.14-r0 and 10.0.15-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the debug packages and the files inside the nupkg, zip and tar.gz archives they hold: the .NET SDK command-line code (dotnet.dll) ships in every build, in the .NET SDK held by dotnet10-runtime-bootstrap (the SDK itself and its bundled dotnet-watch tool) and in the Microsoft.DotNet.Cli nupkg in dotnet10-runtime-artifacts, and its version is that of each build's SDK: SDK 10.0.102 to 10.0.110 in 10.0.2-r0 to 10.0.10-r0 and SDK 10.0.113 or later from 10.0.13-r0 on; no older SDK copy is present in a later build. The range ends at 10.0.13-r0 because it is the first published build whose SDK is 10.0.113 or later.
